title: Nanomaterials for managing abiotic and biotic stress in the soil–plant system for sustainable agriculture
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00789A, Critical Review
Loren Ochoa, Manoj Shrivastava, Sudhakar Srivastava, Keni Cota-Ruiz, Lijuan Zhao, Jason C. White, Jose Angel Hernandez-Viezcas, Jorge L. Gardea-Torresdey
An optimum application of NPs can mitigate biotic and abiotic stresses, but overuse can cause phytotoxicity. Research on the use of NPs for plant stress is demonstrating promising benefits.
